Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit.
Input image is the EDIT TARGET, not loose inspiration. Deliver ONLY THE EXISTING STONE FOOTBRIDGE from this exact painting, retaining its actual material drawing, irregular rocks, moss, tiny white flowers and natural shallow stone arch. Do not design a different bridge or reinterpret its surface.
Output: genuine transparent PNG, exact same full canvas dimensions as input (1942 by 809 pixels). Keep the existing bridge at the exact original position and pixel scale: its narrow walkable upper surface runs approximately along y=535, rock bridge body and shallow open arch underneath down to y=665. Maintain the reference's uneven low rock ledge, large organically shaped grey-blue granite blocks, delicate ochre/sage moss, small ivory flowers and pale grasses, charcoal ink contours with subtle original watercolour texture. Preserve original detail/resolution, light direction, colours and stone size.
Remove ALL people and animals, and carefully reconstruct ONLY the tiny bridge areas that were occluded by their feet. Remove sky, mountains, trees, lanterns, buildings, water and reflections, and the unrelated large bottom foreground boulders. All outside the bridge must be truly transparent, including the arch opening. Keep only bridge-attached low vegetation. Horizontal bridge reaches both canvas sides continuously with no decorative endcaps or fadeout.
This is an exact extraction with a few occluded spots restored, NOT a new clean grass path, NOT masonry brickwork, NOT a tall wall, NOT a suspension/wooden bridge. Never smooth, simplify, blur, over-sharpen, emboss, darken or increase texture compared with the source. No text, UI, characters or new objects.
left: Use case: illustration-story, adjacent terrain outpainting. Image 1 is the central stone bridge panel which you must CONTINUE at the exact same pixel scale, dimensions (1944x809), drawing resolution and vertical registration. Image 2 is the original full painting, strict material/style reference. Create ONLY an adjacent bridge extension on genuine transparency. Keep the continuous walking surface at y≈460 and organically arranged low grey-blue granite body roughly y=475..625, exactly matching Image 1's soft directional light, charcoal ink edges, restrained detailed watercolor grain, sage/ochre moss, tiny ivory flowers and pale grasses. Large naturally irregular granite boulders, not uniform bricks. Match the original's actual stone sizes and material treatment: do not amplify texture, add gravel noise, emboss, sharpen, simplify or blur. Full-width bridge to BOTH canvas edges, no faded edges/endcaps. No characters, trees, mountains, sky, moon, water, buildings, lanterns, UI or text. No symmetry/mirroring/repetition of motifs. Keep top/bottom outside the bridge fully transparent; preserve native detail and thin upper foot surface. This is the SAME bridge continuing further, not a newly designed earth path or tall masonry wall. New panel lies immediately LEFT of Image 1. The RIGHT edge of your output must meet Image 1's LEFT edge exactly at the same footpath height and bridge thickness, colours and cross section. Continue its rocks and moss into a new asymmetric leftward section with similar gentle low rises, sparse attached flowers. The new section may have a small natural gap underneath, but the WALKABLE TOP stays unbroken. Do not duplicate the central arch. Image 1 remains unchanged outside this generated panel.
